MA.title: Mystery Phone: Friend in Trouble
MA.brief: Kavya almost sent money to someone last evening. No leads this time. Review the device, find the red flags and reconstruct the attack.
MA.closing: A new device, a new story, the same five stages. You identified them without leads.
MA-M01: Hi Kavya, it is Kiran bhaiya. My phone fell in water, this is a friend’s number. Save it.
MA-M02: Cannot talk on call, voice is not working. Only message please.
MA-M03: I am in the hospital. Doctor says Rs. 4,000 is needed in 10 minutes or treatment cannot start.
MA-M04: Send to this number on PayNow: 90XXXXXX55. Name is R Mohan, my friend’s father. Hurry.
MA-M05: Please do not tell Aunty or anyone, she will worry.
MA-M06: Message not delivered. This number is switched off.
MA-M08: Practical exam on Monday. Carry your record.
MA-C01:
Kavya: “Bhaiya, are you okay?”
Kiran: “I am fine! Why, what happened?”
MA-C01.explain: Kavya called the real Kiran, who was at home. This check is what stops this scam.
MA-C02: Mom: Who is coming for dinner?
MA-N01: Unsent draft: R Mohan, 90XXXXXX55, Rs. 4,000. Status: Not paid.
MA-01.explain: A new number saying it is me proves nothing. Anyone can type a name.
MA-02.explain: Not wanting to talk is how they hide a voice that is not Kiran’s.
MA-03.explain: Ten minutes is the rush. It stops Kavya from calling anyone first.
MA-04.explain: The name asked to be paid is not Kiran’s. Check who gets the money before you send.
MA-05.explain: After Kavya checked, the number went dead. Real relatives do not vanish when you call.
MA-G1.explain: Do not tell anyone keeps you from asking the people who really know Kiran.
MA.fix.q: A new number says it is your cousin and needs money right now. What is the safest first step?
MA.fix.a: Send a small amount first to test whether it really is him.
MA.fix.a.why: Any payment can be lost, and a test payment proves nothing about who is on the other end.
MA.fix.b: Call your cousin on the number you already have, or ask another family member.
MA.fix.b.why: Yes. Check through a contact you already trust.
MA.fix.c: Ask him to send a selfie.
MA.debrief.mechanism: The attacker relied on a plausible emergency and a change of channel (a new number). Refusing calls hides that the voice is not the relative's. The payee name differing from the relative is the key technical tell, and the instruction not to tell anyone prevents the check that would expose it.
MA.debrief.c1: Call the person on the number you already have, or ask another family member.
MA.debrief.c2: Compare the payee name with who you expect to be paid before you send.
MA.debrief.c3: An emergency plus a request for secrecy is a recognisable pattern.
